verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime novel first-book-publication span, from Decline and Fall to Unconditional Surrender, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The eight selected markers use original English-language book-publication years, not composition, magazine serialization, translation or adaptation dates. Brideshead Revisited uses its 1945 first edition, not the revised 1960 text. Sword of Honour (1965) revises and collects the three wartime novels originally published in 1952, 1955 and 1961; it does not extend this first-publication bar. Short fiction, including Basil Seal Rides Again (1963), juvenilia, journalism, travel writing, biographies, the autobiography A Little Learning (1964) and posthumous releases are outside this novel-only scope.
